notes: family: drafting-pattern-scoring. Pages and cubes are cleared during play: use the final running total. Completed illustration values, activated page multipliers, workspace and technique effects must be resolved when each page turns. Partial illustrations score zero. After finishing, each subsequent turn gains 3 points and advances the Abbot. Component-dependent values are inputs through the recorded track; solo rules are separate.
